item.title: Report: Hezbollah preparing for a regional war
item.description:
Hezbollah has been preparing for the renewal of Israeli attacks over the past three months, while at the same time receiving tens of millions of dollars from Iran to restore its military capabilities, according to a report by the Reuters news agency.
Sources in Lebanon said that the organization is also working to rehabilitate its top leadership. Earlier this month, Reuters reported that Iran had transferred about $200 million to Hezbollah for military rehabilitation purposes.

item.title: 17-year-old girl hospitalized in serious condition due to flu complications
item.description: A teenage girl with no underlying medical conditions is hospitalized in intensive care at Assuta Ashdod Hospital following a severe complication of influenza. Her condition deteriorated within hours, and she is now sedated and on a ventilator.
